title: SURF/UNL Read & Publish + Scopus — 2027 Extension Decision
notes: Current 2-year deal (Jan 2025–Dec 2026) includes an optional 3rd-year extension to Dec 2027 requiring 90 days written notice = decision deadline ~1 Oct 2026. Covers 14 universities (UNL), 7 UMCs (NFU), NWO-i, KNAW, 23 hogescholen. If not extended: full open re-tender expected for 2028. Renewal negotiations active NOW.

title: Jisc Research Management Systems DPS — UK University CRIS Call-offs
institution: Jisc (on behalf of UK Higher Education Institutions)
notes: Live DPS framework (launched April 2024). UK universities run mini-competitions through it in ~4 weeks. Elsevier Pure is pre-qualified alongside Symplectic, Vidatum, 4Science (DSpace-CRIS), Worktribe. Multiple institutions expected to procure through 2026-2028. Monitor Jisc for individual call-offs — each is a biddable event.

title: IReL — Scopus / SciVal Framework Re-tender (Post-Cancellation)
notes: Original TED 598844-2025 (€42.1M, 72-month open framework) cancelled 2025 — zero responses received. IReL then secured a direct ScienceDirect Read & Publish deal 2026-2028 outside procurement. A separate Scopus/SciVal re-tender under a negotiated or restricted procedure is expected in 2026-2027. Watch eTenders.gov.ie and TED for new notice.

title: Atlantic Technological University — Library Databases DPS
notes: TED 391344-2026 (OJ S 108/2026). Contract awarded June 2026. DPS for library databases and online resources for Irish Technological Universities — covers science, engineering, health, business, arts databases. Multi-lot, multi-year framework. Reference win for Irish sector.

title: Max Planck Society — Electronic Journals & Databases 2025-2028
notes: TED 50580-2026. Max Planck awarded EBSCO a 3-year contract (Dec 2025–Dec 2028) for electronic specialist literature and databases. Displacement risk for Elsevier in German research sector. Re-tender window: 2028. Monitor for parallel Springer/De Gruyter and ScienceDirect contract status at MPG.
